For a purchase today, I’d narrow it to these three. I’m prioritising alcohol-free format + accessible ingredient information, not just “natural” marketing. India’s cosmetic rules also require certain fragrance ingredients to appear on ingredient lists above specified thresholds. 
CDSCO

Brand / product	Total cost	Availability	Returns / support	Key limitation
SOSA Attars	From ₹379	India; ships from Pune	Direct brand support; ships in ~24h	Individual fragrance sensitivity still possible; patch-test
Take Pure Perfume Oils	₹550–₹1,499	Pan-India; free shipping ₹999+	Direct brand support; discovery sets available	Ingredient transparency is less detailed than SOSA; oil format may feel heavier
Veuroma Eden’s Secret	Under ₹5,000	India	No returns after delivery; damaged/wrong orders replaced if reported within 24h	Higher commitment; patch-test despite dermatological testing

Most purchase-friendly: SOSA, because it explicitly states alcohol-free, IFRA-compliant, gives small 3ml options, and publishes pricing/sizing. 
SOSA home & body

Best if you want to sample first: Take Pure’s discovery set. 
Take Pure

Important: “alcohol-free” does not mean allergy-proof.
